text: 尽管铜价飙升，智利8月铜出口量仍跌至一年多来的最低水平，原因是这个全球最大铜生产国正面临严重冬季风暴和矿山运营挫折的双重困扰。 据周一公布的央行数据显示，上月智利铜出口额为46.2亿美元，较7月下降14%，较去年同期下降3.2%。这是2025年7月以来的最低月度出口额。而与此同时，铜价却在走强——8月铜均价较去年同期上涨超过40%。
text_en: Despite surging copper prices, Chile's copper exports fell to their lowest level in more than a year in August, as the world's largest copper producer grapples with severe winter storms and mining operational setbacks. Central bank data released Monday showed copper export revenue of $4.62 billion last month, down 14% from July and 3.2% year-on-year—the lowest monthly figure since July 2025. The decline came amid stronger copper prices, with August average prices up more than 40% year-on-year.
